segments.contextAfter: The helper tool must have an embedded launchd property list. The only required key in this property list is the `Label` key. When the Service Management framework extracts the `launchd` property list and writes it to disk, it sets the key for `ProgramArguments` to an array of 1 element that points to a standard location. You can’t specify your own program arguments, so don’t rely on the system passing custom command line arguments to your tool. Pass any parameters through an inter-process communication (IPC) channel.
